'''Buccaneers' Haven''' is an island west of the [[Piscatoris Fishing Colony]] and east of [[Port Piscarilius]]. It requires 76 [[Sailing]] (not boostable) to moor on.

A castle can be found on the eastern end of the island containing [[pirate]]s.

Once the rowboat is built, the player may travel to and from the island using a rowboat on the south coast of [[Pirates' Cove]], provided they've previously been taken to Pirates' Cove during [[Lunar Diplomacy]].

The [[Buccaneers' Laboratory]] can be accessed through this island.

==Features==
* A [[fishing spot]] for [[lantern harpooning]].
* Anvil, furnace, rowboat ([[Pirate's Cove]]), and bank chest [[Hotspot|hotspots]].
* [[Lockbox (Buccaneers' Haven)|Lockbox]] containing the [[eternal brazier schematic]], which is opened with a [[Small key (Tear of the Soul)|small key]] which is found on the [[Tear of the Soul]].
* [[Small key (Buccaneers' Haven)]] can be dug up by entering the Buccaneers' Laboratory and digging on the red ball in the north-western prison room. This is used to unlock a [[Lockbox (Deepfin Point)|lockbox]] on [[Deepfin Point]] containing the [[dragon cannon schematic]].
